learning_outcomes.text: Solve problems involving distributed parameter circuit analysis, microwave circuits, and systems.
Design impedance matching circuits for power flow along a transmission line and maximum power transfer.
Perform graphical solutions of transmission line circuits.
Understand the equivalences between waveguides and transmission lines.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to transmission lines and review of basic concepts
Lumped element circuit model and transmission line equations
Lossless transmission line, reflection coefficient, transmission coefficient, standing wave ratio, input impedance of the transmission line
Special cases in lossless transmission lines: short-circuit termination, open-circuit termination, second line
Power flow in transmission lines: instantaneous power, average power
Midterm exam solutions and transmission line applications
Termination of a transmission line with a load impedance and derivation as a function of line parameters
Smith chart: parametric equations, input impedance
Smith chart: SWR, voltage maximum and minimum, impedance - admittance transformation
Impedance matching; topics on filters, amplifiers, oscillators, and mixers
assessment_rules: Midterm and final exam dates are not specified in the 14-week course plan; they are held on the dates specified in the academic calendar by the decision of the University Senate.
